description.p: CONCHA is a collaborative screenwriting and storyboarding platform built for creative teams who write, draw, and produce together. Whether you are drafting a script, blocking out scenes in a storyboard, or roughing out animatics, CONCHA keeps your whole team on the same page in real time.

ul.li: Real-time co-writing with multiple writers in the same document simultaneously
Panel-by-panel storyboarding linked directly to script sections
Flipnote Studio-inspired drawing program for sketching and animatics
3D world space reference for blocking scenes before drawing
In-app voice recording attached to script lines
Plugin support via .Luau for custom tools and export formats
Sign in with Google, GitHub, or Discord

description.p: Strawberry Concha Release 2.0. New features include LUAU plugin support, PDF export, new themes, macOS build, and various bug fixes.
